Here is a cited, structured survey of the code-review and validation mechanisms present at revision `dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b`.

---

## Repository-Wide Mechanisms

### 1. CI Pipeline — Forgejo Actions

**Single workflow file:** [`.forgejo/workflows/build.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/.forgejo/workflows/build.yaml)

Triggers: `push` and `pull_request` on `main`.

Two jobs:

| Job | Trigger condition | What it runs |
|---|---|---|
| `test` | always | `scripts/run-end-to-end-tests` |
| `docs` | `push` only (not PRs) | Builds and pushes docs container image via Podman |

The `docs` job has `needs: [test]` — it is **gated on `test` passing** ([line 18](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/.forgejo/workflows/build.yaml?L18)).

**Verification query:** To confirm whether a given commit's CI run passed, check the Forgejo Actions run log for that SHA on `main` or the corresponding PR.

---

### 2. End-to-End Test Runner

**Script:** [`scripts/run-end-to-end-tests`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/scripts/run-end-to-end-tests)

Orchestrates `docker-compose` (or Podman socket) to spin up database containers defined in `tests/end-to-end/docker-compose.yaml`, attach to the test runner, then tear everything down (`set -e` — any failure aborts).

---

### 3. Unit and Integration Tests

**Directory layout:** [`tests/unit/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/tree/tests/unit), [`tests/integration/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/tree/tests/integration), [`tests/end-to-end/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/tree/tests/end-to-end)

**Test runner:** `pytest` via [`tox.ini`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/tox.ini) (environments: `py310`–`py314`).

**Coverage enforcement** — configured in [`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L50):
```toml
--cov-fail-under=100 --no-cov-on-fail
```
**100% branch/line coverage is required.** A build with any uncovered code fails outright.

**Additional pytest flags** (same line):
- `--timeout=120` — tests that hang for over 2 minutes are killed
- `--asyncio-mode=auto` — `pytest-asyncio` applied automatically
- `--ignore=tests/end-to-end` — end-to-end tests excluded from default `pytest` run (run separately via the CI script)

**Test framework:** `flexmock` (mocking), `pytest-cov`, `pytest-timeout`, `pytest-asyncio` — pinned in [`test_requirements.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/test_requirements.txt).

---

### 4. Linters

All linters run as part of the default `tox` environment ([`tox.ini` lines 17–21](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/tox.ini?L17-L21)):

```
pytest {posargs}
ruff check
ruff format --check
codespell
```

**Ruff** (`ruff check` + `ruff format --check`):
- Covers 20+ rule categories (configured in [`pyproject.toml` lines 59–132](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L59-L132)), including: pyflakes (`F`), bugbear (`B`), isort (`I`), security (`S`/bandit-equivalent), naming (`N`), performance (`PERF`), fixme/TODO detection (`FIX`/`ERA`), and more.
- Line length: 100 characters.
- Quote style: single quotes enforced.
- Per-file ignores relax several security and assertion rules inside `tests/**/*.py`.

**Codespell:** Spell-checking of source files, skipping `.git`, `.tox`, `build`.

**Bandit** (legacy, via `.bandit`): [`.bandit`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/.bandit) — excludes `tests/`, skips `S105` and `S404`. Note: the active linting stack uses Ruff's `S` rules (flake8-bandit) rather than invoking `bandit` directly; the `.bandit` file is a legacy config remnant.

**Dedicated tox environments** for lint-only or format-only runs:
- `tox -e lint` — `ruff check --diff` (diff mode, no fixes)
- `tox -e lint-fix` — `ruff check --fix`
- `tox -e format` — `ruff format`
- `tox -e spell` — `codespell --write-changes`

---

### 5. Generated / Derived File Check

**`test_requirements.txt`** is described as "mostly autogenerated by `uv pip compile`" ([line 1](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/test_requirements.txt?L1)). The source of truth is [`test_requirements.in`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/test_requirements.in). There is **no automated CI check** that validates the `.txt` is in sync with the `.in` — drift must be caught by human review or by a failing install.

**Verification query:** Check whether `test_requirements.txt` hashes match `uv pip compile test_requirements.in` at the cutoff SHA.

---

### 6. Ownership Rules

There is **no `CODEOWNERS` file** or equivalent in the repository at this revision. The [`AUTHORS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/AUTHORS) file exists as an informational credit list, not as an enforceable ownership or review-routing mechanism.

---

### 7. Pull Request Template

[`.forgejo/pull_request_template.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/.forgejo/pull_request_template.md) is a **stub** — it contains only YAML front matter (`name: "Pull Request"`, `about: "Pull Request"`) with no checklist, required fields, or review criteria. It provides no structured review gate.

---

### 8. AI Agent Policy

[`AGENTS.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/AGENTS.md) explicitly prohibits AI agents from modifying the codebase. This is a **documented policy**, not a technical enforcement mechanism.
